description: Source code for managing ClusterTrustBundles in Kubernetes, including informer-based cache management, API version handling, and trust bundle normalization.

classes.name: InformerManager

classes.description: A manager that always returns errors, used in static kubelet mode.

classes.description: Dynamically initializes and manages the appropriate ClusterTrustBundle manager based on API availability.
